source_title: Karan Lamba’s unbeaten hunded puts Rajasthan in command; Kunal Singh Rathore, Sachin Yadav slam fifties; - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Jaipur: Karan Lamba continued his dream run by slamming second hundred of the season to steer Rajasthan to a commanding position against Uttarakhand in Dehradun on Wednesday.On the penultimate day in their Ranji Trophy Elite Group D match at the Abhimanyu Cricket Academy Ground, Rajasthan, who resumed at their overnight score of 39 for 1, declared their second innings at 290 for 5, riding on Karanâs brilliant unbeaten century.As soon as Karan (100 not out: 158b, 9x4, 1x6) completed his landmark, Rajasthan captain Kartik Sharma declared the innings, setting a stiff target of 369 runs for the home team.Vice-captain Kunal Singh Rathore (77: 106, 5x4, 1x6) and opener Sachin Yadav (53: 178b, 3x4) struck half-centuries, while experienced batter Mahipal Lomrorâs cautious knock of 45 gave the innings a strong foundation.Uttarakhand spinner Mayank Mishra claimed 3 for 115, while Avneesh Sudha and Suchith Jagadeesha took one wicket each.Chasing a daunting target of 369, Uttarakhand safely negotiated the tricky last half an hour to end the Day 3 at 38 without loss in 9 overs. Openers Tejasvi Jaiswal and Nischal Dega were batting at the crease on 31, 7, respectively.The hosts still need 331 more runs to win with all ten wickets intact on the final day.
